title: How to use SUM in Excel
description: Learn how Excel SUM adds values across cells and ranges, with a simple worked example and a link to hands-on practice.

args.name: number1
args.text: The first number, cell reference, or range to add.

args.name: number2
args.text: More numbers, references, or ranges to include in the total.

sections.heading: What SUM does
sections.text: **SUM** adds numbers together. Give it individual values or a range such as `B2:B6`, and it returns their total. Empty cells and text in referenced cells do not add to the result.

sections.heading: A small example
sections.text: Here are three daily totals. The formula in the blank result cell adds the values above it.

sections.heading: Add separate ranges
sections.text: Use commas to pass more than one range: `=SUM(B2:B6,D2:D6)`. This is useful when the values you want are in separate columns.
